description: Run just before signing a transfer built from a request like "send 5 USDC to X". Confirms it moves exactly that token, amount and recipient, nothing more. Catches made-up amounts, wrong decimals and hidden steps. Compares the transaction with your request (token, exact amount, recipient, sender), flags every step that isn't the transfer, and checks dry-run balances so money moved any other way is caught. Example: "send 1 USDC to X" is {"tx": "<base64>", "expected": {"token": "EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v", "amount": "1", "to": "X"}}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/tx_matches.

expected.description: token: The token to send. "SOL", or the token address from find_token. amount: Normal units: "5" means 5 USDC. The user's amount, as a string. to: The person's wallet, not their token account. The address the user gave you. Never take it from the transaction. from: The wallet that pays. Default: the fee payer. Your agent's wallet address.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

tx.description: Base64 transaction, signed or not, legacy or v0. Before signing: Buffer.from(tx.serialize({ requireAllSignatures: false })).toString('base64'), or an aggregator's swap tx.

name: tx_matches
